title: Attack and defence reveal specialists that Elo compresses

source.label: Ballistics analysis summary
filters: Strengths are compared within the same league, never by raw goals across leagues.

metricDefinitions.label: Completed fixtures
metricDefinitions.definition: Distinct raw fixtures with final-time status and complete home and away goals.

metricDefinitions.label: Transformed fact coverage
metricDefinitions.definition: Distinct played fixtures in raw.fact_head_to_head divided by completed fixtures in raw.raw_fixtures.

source.label: Current opponent-adjusted league leaders
filters: Strengths are compared within the same league, never by raw goals across leagues.

metricDefinitions.label: Attack index
metricDefinitions.definition: Time-decayed Dixon-Coles attack strength, adjusted for opponent and home advantage, shrunk toward neutral with a six-effective-match prior, and re-centred so the current league geometric mean is 100; higher is stronger.

metricDefinitions.label: Defence index
metricDefinitions.definition: Inverse Dixon-Coles defensive concession effect, adjusted for opponent and home advantage, shrunk toward neutral with a six-effective-match prior, and re-centred so the current league geometric mean is 100; higher is stronger.

metricDefinitions.label: Specialist gap
metricDefinitions.definition: The larger of attack percentile minus Elo percentile and defence percentile minus Elo percentile. It identifies a specialised unit that Elo may obscure; it is not proof of bookmaker value.
